title: Gender Bias in Multimodal Models: A Transnational Feminist Approach Considering Geographical Region and Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating cosine similarity between CLIP image embeddings of men and women and text embeddings of positive/negative words, gendered adjectives, and occupations, and analyzing the gender difference scores.

Comparing gender bias similarity scores across nine global regions and using Grad-CAM with visual question answering to identify associations between cultural/regional visual cues (such as a hijab) and stereotypical labels like 'terrorist'.
